summary_en.motivation: Investigate the effect of heat treatment on the microstructure and mechanical properties of selective laser melted Ti-5Al-2.5Sn alloy.
summary_en.method: The alloy was fabricated by selective laser melting and subsequently subjected to various heat treatments.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment refined the microstructure, leading to improved strength and ductility.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated through tensile testing and hardness measurements.

papers.title: Coculture of Spheroids/2D Cell Layers Using a Miniaturized Patterned Platform as a Versatile Method to Produce Scaffold‐Free Tissue Engineering Building Blocks
papers.abstract: Abstract A hanging drop system that allows the multiconfigurational coculture of 3D microtissues is suggested as a versatile platform to promote the formation of functional preconditioned spheroids/microtissues, namely stem‐cell‐derived tissue engineering microtissues, with potential to be applied as scaffold‐free building blocks. Here, superhydrophobic (SH) platforms patterned with wettable regions are adapted for the production and culture of human adipose‐derived stem‐cell spheroids under indirect coculture with 2D layers of different cell types and direct coculture setups. The versatile indirect and direct coculture setups allow the use of cell lines as soluble biomolecules “factories” to continuously modulate microtissues response aspects, including their viability, cell number, and protein expression. This novel application of patterned SH platforms may find application in the massive production of modulated spheroids for the biomedical and pharmaceutical fields, with specific added value in the biofabrication of 3D constructs for tissue regeneration, as disease models, or even for organoids preparation.

papers.title: [Clinical outcome, complications and prosthesis survival in patients operated with hip resurfacing arthroplasty].
papers.abstract: Hip resurfacing arthroplasty (RHA) was introduced as a superior alternative to the standard total hip arthroplasty (THA) in treating younger, more active patients. Early failure associated with adverse reactions to metal debris is now a known complication after hip resurfacing. There is no short-term difference in clinical outcome between patients operated with THA and RHA, and those operated with RHA are at greater risk of reoperation. Follow-up of patients having had RHA is recommended to follow national guidelines.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅讨论髋关节表面置换术的临床结果和并发症，未涉及任何生物力学建模或应力遮挡分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical outcomes study of hip resurfacing arthroplasty with no FE modeling, no stress analysis in Gruen zones, no micromotion quantification, and no patient-specific or population-based biomechanical comparison.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估髋关节表面置换术相比全髋置换术的临床优势和并发症。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性临床研究，比较RHA和THA的预后。
summary_zh.result: RHA早期失败率高，再手术风险大，临床结果无短期差异。
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床随访数据，无生物力学验证。

summary_en.motivation: To compare clinical outcomes and complications between hip resurfacing arthroplasty and total hip arthroplasty in younger active patients.
summary_en.method: A retrospective clinical study analyzing complication rates, reoperation risk, and prosthesis survival from follow-up data.
summary_en.result: Hip resurfacing showed higher early failure rates and greater reoperation risk with no short-term clinical advantage over total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.validation: Validation is based on clinical follow-up data without any biomechanical or computational modeling.
